subject: 2 accessibility gaps: missing aria-labels + print CSS
body:
GA — two findings from new GP test suite (gp-aria-labels.test.js + gp-print-css.test.js):

BUG 1: Missing aria-label on canvas elements (WCAG 2.1)
Files: final_exam_251123.html, nonlinear_exam_mvp.html
Impact: Screen readers cannot describe graph content. Kai uses Chrome — aria-labels also show on hover.
Fix: Add aria-label='Graph for question N' to each <canvas> element.
- final_exam_251123.html: chart9, chart13, chart15, chart19
- nonlinear_exam_mvp.html: graphQ12, graphQ13

BUG 2: Missing @media print CSS
Files: exam.html, final_exam_251123.html
Impact: If Kai prints a test, buttons/inputs render in print output. Cluttered.
Fix: Add @media print { .btn, input, button { display: none; } } block to both files.
index.html already has print CSS — copy that pattern.

These are both non-blocking but accessibility matters. Flagging as medium priority.

Tests:
  node tests/gp-aria-labels.test.js — currently exits 1 (6 failures)
  node tests/gp-print-css.test.js — currently exits 1 (2 failures)

— GP
